verdict.rationale: Intel's own docs list ONNX Runtime, DirectML, OpenVINO, and WebNN as supported AI frameworks for the CPU, and reference oneDNN/PyTorch optimizations for Core Ultra processors and Arc GPUs, showing vendor-documented local-AI stack support. However, there's no explicit mention of llama.cpp or MLX support, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming these runtimes actually run well on the 285K (community coverage focuses on gaming/productivity, not AI inference). Missing for 10: llama.cpp support confirmation, independent benchmarks of ONNX/OpenVINO inference on this chip, NPU-specific inference documentation for this desktop SKU.
